item.title: Week 10: Jaguars at Titans
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: JAX -10.5 · O/U 45.5 | Model TEN 19% vs. market 17% | On paper Jacksonville has the edge (Jacksonville ranks 3rd in EPA per dropback, +0.29), while Tennessee's best counter is to keep the pocket clean (Tennessee ranks 5th in QB hit + sack rate, 13%). Under center, Trevor Lawrence ranks 2nd of 31 in EPA per dropback and Cam Ward ranks 26th; x-factor: Parker Washington gets 24% of Jacksonville's targets and 33% of its air yards, and Tennessee's pass defense ranks 30th. The model favors Jacksonville at 81%, mostly on passing matchup (6.4 pts) and starting QB (4.0 pts).
